setting.runtime: Installed official Codex executable (0.152.0 or newer; 0.152.0 and 0.162.0-alpha are tested). Reload the window after changing.
setting.locale: Interface language. Auto follows the VS Code display language; other languages fall back to English. Does not change model responses or speech language.
setting.sendKey: Send with Enter (Shift+Enter adds a new line) or with Ctrl/Cmd+Enter. IME composition never sends.
setting.permissionMode: Approval mode for new chats. This client setting overrides approval_policy from Codex config for chats it starts; the sandbox profile still comes from Codex config.
setting.permissionMode.ask: Ask before edits: Codex shows each file change in the diff editor and waits; commands also ask (approval_policy untrusted).
setting.permissionMode.auto: Edit automatically inside the sandbox (approval_policy on-request).
setting.autosave: Save open workspace files before sending a message or approving a change, so Codex sees what you see.
setting.attachOpenFile: Mention the active file (path only) with each message.
setting.attachSelection: Include the selected lines from the active editor with each message.
